title: Meetings Vocabulary
completion_message: ¡Genial! Has aprendido el vocabulario clave para participar y organizar reuniones de trabajo en inglés.

parts.visual: Elementos clave: Agenda (orden del día / temas a tratar), Minutes (minuta / acta de la reunión), Attendee (asistente / participante), Chair / Chairperson (moderador / quien dirige la reunión).
parts.audio: Key elements of a meeting: Agenda, which is the list of topics. Minutes, which is the written record of the meeting. Attendee, which is a participant. And Chair or Chairperson, the person leading the meeting.

parts.visual: Acciones comunes: To schedule (programar), To attend (asistir), To postpone (posponer), To cancel (cancelar), To take notes (tomar notas).
parts.audio: Common actions: To schedule, to attend, to postpone, to cancel, and to take notes.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la palabra de vocabulario correcta sobre reuniones.

questions.question: Did everyone receive the meeting ____? (Orden del día / Temas).
questions.explanation: Agenda = orden del día (los temas a tratar).

questions.question: Who is going to write the ____? (Minuta / Acta).
questions.explanation: Minutes = minuta o acta de la reunión.

questions.question: Sarah is the ____ of the committee. (Moderadora/Presidenta de la reunión).
questions.explanation: Chair / Chairperson = quien dirige o modera la reunión.

questions.question: We need to ____ a meeting for next week. (Programar).
I cannot ____ the meeting tomorrow. (Asistir a).
questions.explanation: Attend = asistir a un evento ('assist' significa ayudar).

questions.question: We must ____ the meeting until Friday. (Posponer).
The manager decided to ____ the meeting. It's not happening. (Cancelar).
Can you ____ notes during the presentation? (Tomar).
Let's stick to the ____. (Apeguémonos al orden del día).
questions.explanation: Stick to the agenda = no salirse del tema.

questions.question: I will send you the ____ tomorrow morning. (La minuta).
questions.explanation: Send the minutes = enviar la minuta.

questions.question: The ____ opened the meeting at 9 AM. (Moderador).
I will ____ an invitation via email. (Enviar).
questions.explanation: Send an invitation = enviar una invitación.

questions.question: Please review the ____ before the meeting. (Los temas a tratar).
The meeting will take ____ in Room A. (Se llevará a cabo).
Let's ____ a quick meeting to discuss this. (Tener).
questions.explanation: Have a meeting = tener una reunión.

questions.question: Who is taking the ____ today? (La minuta / notas formales).
questions.explanation: Take the minutes = redactar la minuta.

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase exacta.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Did everyone receive the meeting agenda?
options: Did everyone receive the meeting agenda?
Did you receive the meeting agenda?
Did everyone read the meeting agenda?
Has everyone received the meeting agenda?
questions.correct_answer: Did everyone receive the meeting agenda?

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Who is going to write the minutes?
options: Who is going to write the minutes?
Who is going to read the minutes?
questions.correct_answer: Who is going to write the minutes?

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: There are ten attendees in this meeting.
options: There are ten attendees in this meeting.
There are twenty attendees in this meeting.
There are ten people in this meeting.
We have ten attendees in this meeting.
questions.correct_answer: There are ten attendees in this meeting.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Sarah is the chair of the committee.
options: Sarah is the chair of the committee.
Sarah is the leader of the committee.
John is the chair of the committee.
Sarah is the manager of the committee.
questions.correct_answer: Sarah is the chair of the committee.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: We need to schedule a meeting.
options: We need to schedule a meeting.
I need to schedule a meeting.
We need to cancel a meeting.
We have to schedule a meeting.
questions.correct_answer: We need to schedule a meeting.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I cannot attend the meeting tomorrow.
options: I cannot attend the meeting tomorrow.
I cannot attend the meeting today.
She cannot attend the meeting tomorrow.
I can't attend the meeting tomorrow.
questions.correct_answer: I cannot attend the meeting tomorrow.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
options: We have to postpone the meeting.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Can you take notes during the presentation?
options: Can you take notes during the presentation?
Could you take notes during the presentation?
Can you make notes during the presentation?
Can you take notes during the meeting?
questions.correct_answer: Can you take notes during the presentation?
